args.title: Warehouse Automation 2026 – Combined Summary (Halvorsen)
args.body:
- Productivity: Autonomous carts raised warehouse pick rates by 18% in 2026.
- Implementation: Integration took about twice as long as planned, so expect longer rollout timelines.
- Biggest saving: According to the companion piece, the largest cost benefit came from fewer mis-picks.

Sources: https://blog.halvorsen.example/2026/warehouse ; https://insights.halvorsen.example/warehouse/companion
